description: This file contains benchmark tests (using BenchmarkDotNet and xUnit) for Orleans serialization and copying operations on complex object graphs, including classes and structs with circular references. It defines a class 'ComplexTypeBenchmarks' that initializes serializers, copiers, messages, and sequences, and implements various test and benchmark methods.

classes.name: ComplexTypeBenchmarks
classes.description: A class for benchmarking Orleans serialization performance on complex object graphs with circular references, using BenchmarkDotNet and xUnit. It prepares serializers, copiers, messages, and sequences, and defines various test and benchmark methods.

methods.name: SerializeComplex
methods.description: Serializes the '_value' object using Orleans serializer and reads it back to test serialization/deserialization cycle.

methods.name: CopyComplex
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the '_value' object using the copier.

methods.name: CopyComplexStruct
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the '_structValue' struct using the copier.

methods.name: OrleansStructRoundTrip
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes '_structValue' struct, returning the result.

methods.name: OrleansClassRoundTrip
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes '_value' object, returning the result.

methods.name: OrleansSerialize
methods.description: Serializes '_value' object and resets the session.

methods.name: OrleansDeserialize
methods.description: Resets session and deserializes the payload into an object.

methods.name: OrleansReadEachByte
methods.description: Reads each byte of the serialized payload, XOR-ing them to produce a checksum.
